versions.subject: Merge PR #5479 from @swachchhanda000 - Webdav CVE-2025-33053 RCE vulnerability
versions.detection:
selection_img_path:
    Image|startswith: '\\\\'
    Image|contains: '\DavWWWRoot\'
selection_img_bin:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\route.exe'
        - '\netsh.exe'
        - '\makecab.exe'
        - '\dxdiag.exe'
        - '\ipconfig.exe'
        - '\explorer.exe'
condition: all of selection_*
